title: BrainerLab circuit dataset (curated, bundled file)
description: Schema for files in data/processed/*.json. Enforced by engine/neurolab_engine/connectome.py (Connectome) and documented in docs/datasets.md. weight=null means unknown/unquantified — never silently treated as 1 outside the documented model step.

species.description: Species key from data/registry/datasets.json, e.g. caenorhabditis_elegans

source.description: Where the data came from (lab, archive, or 'BrainerLab' for own illustrative subsets)

publication.description: Citable publication for the circuit identity or wiring data

license.description: Dataset licence. Code licence (MIT) never covers datasets.

neurons.description: Human-readable node scope, e.g. '16 neurons (6 sensory, 8 interneurons, 2 motor representatives)'

completeness.description: What the file covers — and what it does NOT cover

type.description: e.g. 'illustrative model subset (NOT observed weights)' vs 'observed biological data'

position_note.description: Present when x/y are schematic display-only coordinates, not measured anatomy

function.description: Functional note with cited source, not a new claim

weight.description: null = unknown/unquantified (reference subsets); counts in Varshney-derived files
